text:
maria (infra): FYI — we just flagged a DOA batch affecting eu-central: 24 H100s (serials range provided by GaiaTech). This drops available EU capacity by ~28% next week. Need plan for short-term top-up + RMA flow.

sam (procurement): @maria can you paste the AWB / RMA numbers? vendor sent expedited pricing? we might need to approve air. :grimacing:

GaiaTech Rep: maria, Sam — AWB GAI-EBU-987654321. RMA ID: RMA-2026-0721. Confirmed 24 units DOA on arrival inspection. We can ship a partial replacement immediately: up to 8 units via air this week, remaining 16 in a second wave (~12–16 days) unless you upgrade to premium expedite (adds ~$900/unit). HS code on proforma is 8471.80-000.

jin (ops): If we only get 8 now we still breach our 99th percentile SLA for queued requests in eu-south. Can we divert some traffic to us-west spill for 48–72h while we top up? need TTL routing change.

maria (infra): Yes, Jin — plan to route best-effort to us-west for non-PII tenants. I'll open a canary route. But that still leaves customer-facing latency risk for enterprise customers pinned to EU.

elena (logistics): Sam, I can accept the 8-unit partial air and cross-dock on arrival at FRA hub. Need PO# and proforma invoice to release. Also request consolidated AWB for the second wave to avoid two customs clears.

sam (procurement): PO 2026-RED-1198 approved for first wave (up to $72k). I'll confirm whether finance signs off on premium expedite for rest. Sam to @GaiaTech: can you provide itemized expedite vs sea cost?

GaiaTech Rep: Itemized: air (per unit) = $3,200 (inc. courier + insurance), sea/air-mix = $1,150 (longer lead). Premium expedite reduces second-wave ETA to 4–6 days but costs $1,800 extra/unit. We can consolidate second-wave under a single AWB if you push a consolidated pickup before EOD tomorrow.

jin (ops): Requesting serial list for the 8 units being sent immediately — need to pre-register MACs/firmware & check certs. Also log note: earlier packet loss to eu-south last 03:02UTC caused health probes to mark 3 nodes degraded — unrelated but tight window.

maria (infra): GaiaTech — can you include serials in the pickup manifest and tag the units with temp loaner labels? We want easy depot swap. If units arrive, we will stage them to rack-12 in FRA and mark as "air-topup-temp".

GaiaTech Rep: Will include serials. Manifest snippet we will send: ```
SN: H100-GB-0001245..H100-GB-0001252
Model: H100-80GB
RMA: RMA-2026-0721
```
All 8 units will be marked as "replacement - warranty" on proforma.

elena (logistics): Noted. I'll coordinate cross-dock and clear customs under our existing broker (DHL customs broker ID: RBW-445). Please send proforma and AWB PDF to logistics@redwood.ai.

sam (procurement): Finance flagged that premium expedite for 16 units is ~ $28.8k extra — can we instead reassign 10 units from planned US reserve pool (US spare pool = 14 H100s available) and air-shift 6 for premium? That would cut cost and still meet capacity. Thoughts?

maria (infra): Reassigning 10 from US reduces US slack a bit but acceptable if we delay a planned model eval job. Jin: can you formalize traffic shift plan and expected SLO impact if we move 10 GPUs out of US?

jin (ops): I'll simulate routing shift. Quick note: cross-region transfer requires re-tagging and a hardware provenance update in our inventory DB. ETA for re-tagging + transit is ~36h. If we do 10 from US -> EU via ground, they'll be late. Air shift of those 10 is possible but will incur ~$2.5k/unit.

GaiaTech Rep: If you want to mix vendor air + internal reassign, we can hold the second-wave in vendor staging for 48h for consolidation. Need confirmation by 18:00UTC to lock consolidated AWB.

maria (infra): Action items: 1) Sam confirm final payment route for second-wave by 18:00UTC. 2) GaaiTech send manifest + proforma to logistics@redwood.ai. 3) Jin produce a short SLO impact note and routing toggle plan. I'll create a canary policy to shift non-enterprise traffic first.

deploy-bot: note: route-shift plan created by maria — canary route id: route-eu-temp-20260321. Monitor for latency > 150ms for 3m then rollback.

elena (logistics): All good — I'll ack receipt once proforma lands. Please cc customs broker.

sam (procurement): I'll loop in finance and confirm by 16:30UTC. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
